h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Guwahati

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Guwahati

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Guwahati

c: Guwahati is about 2,070 km from our Vasai factory, so we plan every order for the city as one complete shipment. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to housing societies, schools, colleges, government campuses and city parks in Guwahati. The machines travel by road across the country, and our installation team or a dealer in the north-east fixes them on site.

A long road trip means it is worth agreeing the full list of machines before dispatch, so nothing has to follow in a second truck. We send a layout drawing with every station and its clear space marked, and we confirm the quote once your committee approves the plan. Guwahati's humid summers and heavy monsoon rain also call for frames that do not rust, which is why ours are galvanised pipe. Share photos of the site and the size of the area to get started.

richText.heading: Ordering for a city far from the factory

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 2,070 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment to Guwahati?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our factory in Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in the north-east. We plan the full order together so it can travel as one shipment.

items.q: How does the equipment handle Guwahati's heavy rain?
items.a: Frames are galvanised pipe and seats are roto-moulded plastic, both made for outdoor use. Drain the area well, wipe moving parts after long wet spells and check bolts after the monsoon.

items.q: Can we add more machines later?
items.a: Yes. Each station stands on its own base, so new machines can be fixed beside the first set. For a city this far away, we suggest adding them in one planned batch.
